أكترب (form VIII)
# أَكْتَرِبُ (ʔaktaribu) /ʔak.ta.ri.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِكْتَرَبَ (iktaraba)
# أَكْتَرِبَ (ʔaktariba) /ʔak.ta.ri.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِكْتَرَبَ (iktaraba)
# أَكْتَرِبْ (ʔaktarib) /ʔak.ta.rib/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِكْتَرَبَ (iktaraba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
